cards.task: Pick up the key, then reach the goal.

wrong.why: Takes the key and opens the door, then waits and never reaches the goal.
Never takes the key and never reaches the goal.

paraphrases: Take the key and then get to the goal.
Grab the key first, then make your way to the goal.
After you have picked up the key, reach the goal.
cards.notes: The other clause is implied by the finish, so the env reward pays exactly when it is done.

cards.task: Flip the switch on the wall.

wrong.why: Ignores the siren and never touches the switch.

paraphrases: Toggle the wall switch.
Operate the switch fixed to the wall.
At some point, flip the wall switch.

cards.task: Open the door and pick up the box in the other room.

wrong.why: Takes the key and opens the door, then waits and never picks up the box.

cards.task: Pick up the ball that blocks the door.

wrong.why: Does nothing, so the ball stays in front of the door.

cards.task: Get into the locked room and pick up the ball.

wrong.why: Takes the key and opens the locked door, then waits outside the room.

cards.task: Open the door.

wrong.why: Does nothing, so the door stays locked.

cards.task: Be holding the key on at least two different moves, then pick up the box in the other room.

wrong.why: Holds the key and opens the door, then waits and never picks up the box.

paraphrases: First have the key in your hands on at least two separate moves; afterwards pick up the box in the other room.
Pick up the box in the other room, after you were holding the key on at least two different moves.
Hold the key on two or more different moves, and then take the box from the other room.
cards.notes: State reading: the judge counts two different steps with the state true (not necessarily consecutive). The other clause is implied by the finish, so the env reward pays exactly when it is done. Any successful box pickup holds the key on two or more steps, so the counting clause cannot be isolated on this goal card; the nogoal sibling tests it.

cards.task: Be holding the key on at least two different moves.

wrong.why: Picks up the key and drops it on the next move, so it is held on one step only.
Never takes the key.

paraphrases: Hold the key on two or more different moves.
Carry the key on at least two different moves.
Have the key in your hands on at least two separate moves.

cards.task: Be holding the key on at least two different moves, then pick up the box in the other room.

wrong.why: Clears the ball and takes the key, opens the door, then waits and never picks up the box.

cards.task: Be holding the matching key on at least two different moves.

wrong.why: Picks up the key and drops it on the next move, so it is held on one step only.

cards.task: Be holding the key on at least two different moves, open the door and reach the goal.

wrong.why: Holds the key and opens the door, then waits and never reaches the goal.

cards.task: Be holding the key on at least two different moves.

wrong.why: Picks up the key and drops it on the next move, so it is held on one step only.

cards.task: Pick up the box in the other room, and never lose the key before the door is open.

wrong.why: Drops the key before the door is open, picks it up again, then finishes.
Keeps the key and opens the door, then waits and never picks up the box.

paraphrases: Never lose the key before the door is open, and pick up the box in the other room.
Get the box from the other room, and do not drop the key before opening the door.
You must not lose the key until the door has been opened. Pick up the box in the other room.
cards.notes: With the finish, Absence(key_lost) and NotCoExistence(key_lost, door_open) mean the same.

cards.task: Never open the locked door.

wrong.why: Takes the key and opens the locked door.

paraphrases: Do not open the locked door.
Keep the locked door shut.
The locked door must never be opened.

cards.task: Reach the goal, and never lose the key before the door is open.

wrong.why: Drops the key before the door is open, picks it up again, then finishes.
Keeps the key and opens the door, then waits and never reaches the goal.

cards.task: Don't drop the key while the door is still closed.

wrong.why: Takes the key first and drops it again to free its hands for the ball.

cards.task: Pick up the box in the other room, and never lose the key before the door is open.

wrong.why: Takes the key before the ball and has to drop it with the door closed, then finishes.

cards.task: Never touch the switch on the wall.

wrong.why: Turns the siren off with the switch.

cards.notes: The siren rings, so the solving plan has to leave it ringing.

cards.task: After you find the key, open the locked door. Then pick up the ball.

wrong.why: Takes the key, then waits: the locked door is never opened.
Takes the key and opens the locked door, then waits and never picks up the ball.

paraphrases: Once you find the key, you have to open the locked door afterwards; then take the ball.
Open the locked door after you find the key, and then pick up the ball.
When you find the key, open the locked door afterwards. Finally, pick up the ball.
cards.notes: The response is the door, which stays open to the end (the key is dropped later). Known limit: Response on a state that can turn false (door shut again) needs the response at the trace end; a trace that opens then shuts the door fails this clause.

cards.task: After you move the ball away from the door, pick up the key.

wrong.why: Moves the ball, then waits and never takes the key.

paraphrases: Once the ball is out of the way of the door, pick up the key.
Pick up the key after you have moved the ball away from the door.
When you have moved the ball away from the door, take the key afterwards.
cards.notes: Known limit: Response on a state that can turn false (key dropped again) needs the response at the trace end; once the ball has moved, a trace that takes the key then drops it (and does not take it again) fails this clause.

cards.task: Whenever you pick up the key, open the door afterwards, then reach the goal.

wrong.why: Takes the key, then waits: the door is never opened.
Takes the key and opens the door, then waits and never reaches the goal.

cards.notes: No also_ok: Response and Precedence on a state that can turn false again are not equivalent. Known limit: Response on a state that can turn false (door shut again) needs the response at the trace end; a trace that opens then shuts the door fails this clause.

cards.task: After you pick up the key, open the door.

wrong.why: Takes the key, then waits: the door is never opened.

cards.notes: Known limit: Response on a state that can turn false (door shut again) needs the response at the trace end; a trace that opens then shuts the door fails this clause.

cards.task: After you take the key, open the door, and then pick up the box in the other room.

wrong.why: Clears the ball and takes the key, then waits: the door is never opened.

cards.notes: Known limit: Response on a state that can turn false (door shut again) needs the response at the trace end; a trace that opens then shuts the door fails this clause.

cards.task: After you find the key, open the locked door.

wrong.why: Takes the key, then waits: the locked door is never opened.

cards.notes: Known limit: Response on a state that can turn false (door shut again) needs the response at the trace end; a trace that opens then shuts the door fails this clause.

cards.task: Move the ball away from the door before you take the key, then open the door and pick up the box.

wrong.why: Takes the key before the ball is moved, then fixes it and finishes.
Does it in the right order but waits after opening the door.

paraphrases: Before taking the key, move the ball away from the door. Then open the door and pick up the box.
Take the key only after the ball is out of the way, then open the door and pick up the box.
First move the ball off the door, then take the key, open the door and pick up the box.
cards.notes: Not forced by the env: the key can be taken first (it is then dropped to free the hands).

cards.task: Flip the switch before you go through the exit.

wrong.why: Ignores the siren, so the exit is reached with no switch toggled before.

paraphrases: Before you go through the exit, flip the switch.
Do not go through the exit until you have flipped the switch.
Toggle the switch first, and only then go through the exit.
cards.notes: The first ring comes at step 1-4 and the exit is at least 6 moves away, so the policy toggles first.

cards.task: Do not drop the key until the door is open. Reach the goal.

wrong.why: Drops the key before the door is open, picks it up again, then finishes.

cards.task: Don't drop the key until the door is open.

wrong.why: Drops the key at once, with the door still closed.

cards.task: Pick up the box in the other room, but do not drop the key until the door is open.

wrong.why: Drops the key before the door is open, picks it up again, then finishes.

cards.task: Move the ball away from the door before you take the key.

wrong.why: Takes the key before the ball is moved.

cards.task: Whenever the box falls, pick it up again on your very next move, and then reach the exit.

wrong.why: Does not react to the fall and never picks the box up again.

paraphrases: Each time the box falls, pick it up on your very next move. Then reach the exit.
Go to the exit, and if the box falls, pick it up again on the very next move.
Reach the exit; every time the box falls, your very next move must pick it up again.
cards.notes: Event room only: box_fell is an event, so the judge table can hold. The next-step pickup works when the box lands on the free front cell (the first cell tried). The env require holding_box is deliberate: a fall only starts after a pickup.

cards.task: Whenever the box falls, pick it up again on your very next move.

wrong.why: Does not react to the fall and never picks the box up again.

paraphrases: Should the box fall, make your very next move the one that picks it back up.
Every time the box falls, your very next move must pick it up again.
After the box falls, the move right after it has to pick it up again.

cards.task: Reach the exit. Each time the box falls, your very next move must pick it up again.

wrong.why: Does not react to the fall and never picks the box up again.

cards.notes: The siren rings too; the task ignores it on purpose (distractor). The env require holding_box is deliberate: a fall only starts after a pickup.

cards.task: Each time the box falls, pick it up again on your very next move.

wrong.why: Does not react to the fall and never picks the box up again.

cards.notes: The siren rings too; the task ignores it on purpose (distractor).

cards.task: Get to the exit. If the box falls, pick it up again on your very next move.

wrong.why: Does not react to the fall and never picks the box up again.

cards.notes: The env require holding_box is deliberate: a fall only starts after a pickup.

cards.task: If the box falls, the very next move must pick it up again.

wrong.why: Does not react to the fall and never picks the box up again.

cards.task: If you find the key, you must also open the locked door. Then pick up the ball.

wrong.why: Takes the key, then waits: the locked door is never opened.
Takes the key and opens the locked door, then waits and never picks up the ball.

paraphrases: Should you find the key, you are also required to open the locked door. After that, get the ball.
Finding the key means you must open the locked door too; finally, pick up the ball.
Pick up the ball. If you find the key, you need to open the locked door as well.
cards.notes: Order is free. The other clause is implied by the finish, so the env reward pays exactly when it is done.

cards.task: If you pick up the key, you must also open the door.

wrong.why: Takes the key, then waits: the door is never opened.

paraphrases: If you take the key, you also have to open the door.
Taking the key means you must open the door too.
You must open the door if you pick up the key.

cards.task: If you move the ball, you must also take the key. Then pick up the box in the other room.

wrong.why: Moves the ball, then waits: the key is never taken.
Moves the ball and takes the key, then waits and never picks up the box.

cards.task: If the siren rings, you must flip the switch at some point.

wrong.why: Ignores the siren, so the switch is never toggled.

cards.task: If you take the key, you must also open the door. Then pick up the box in the other room.

wrong.why: Takes the key, then waits: the door is never opened.

cards.task: If you pick up the key, you must also open the door.

wrong.why: Takes the key, then waits: the door is never opened.

cards.task: Reach the goal, but never both lose the key and open the door.

wrong.why: Drops the key, picks it up again, then opens the door and finishes.
Takes the key and opens the door, then waits and never reaches the goal.

paraphrases: Get to the goal, while never letting both of these happen: you lose the key, you open the door.
Reach the goal. You must not lose the key and open the door in the same run.
Make it to the goal; losing the key and opening the door must never both happen.

cards.task: Never both take the key and move the ball away from the door.

wrong.why: Moves the ball and then takes the key, so both happen.

paraphrases: Taking the key and moving the ball away from the door must never both happen.
Do not both pick up the key and move the ball away from the door.
Make sure you never do both: pick up the key and clear the ball from the door.
cards.notes: The key can be reached without moving the ball. Doing neither also satisfies the clause.

cards.task: Pick up the box in the other room, but never both lose the key and open the door.

wrong.why: Drops the key, picks it up again, then opens the door and finishes.

cards.task: Never both lose the key and open the door.

wrong.why: Drops the key, picks it up again, then opens the door.

cards.task: Pick up the box in the other room, but never both lose the key and open the door.

wrong.why: Takes the key before the ball, drops it with the door closed, then finishes.

cards.task: Never both take the matching key and get into the locked room.

wrong.why: Takes the key, opens the locked door and goes in.

cards.notes: Entering the room needs the key, so the only way to obey is to stay out.
